title: Instagram Profile Scraper output
description: One row per Instagram profile that was read, with bio, contacts, links and engagement, plus a run summary that names every username not delivered and why.

profiles.title: Profiles (profiles)
profiles.description: One row per delivered profile: username, name, bio, followers, following, posts, verified, business and category, bio emails (MX-checked) and phones, bio links and where they lead, cross-platform matches, account age, niche and, with a session cookie, engagement and posting patterns. Each row is one charged profile.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record: profiles scraped, private, not found, blocked and failed, each username that was not delivered with the reason, totals of emails, phones and links found, and how many fresh IPs a login wall needed.

log.title: Run log (log)
log.description: Progress per username, retries, and why a profile was skipped.
